provenance.prompt:
A UI frame of the card of the broadcast UI style for an arcade football game framed like a live TV broadcast: a panel's border and ground, its centre plain so text reads on it.
Style: Cinematic realism. Believable materials, human proportions and natural light, organised by cinematic framing, depth and colour control. Physically based materials, natural light, film-like grading and lenses, composition from cinema.
Palette: free, graded; one grade per area; avoid oversaturation; skin tones protected.
Nine-slice: the corners (21% left, 21% top, 21% right, 21% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: none, no outline.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: flat ambient light; saturated game-y colours; stylised outlines; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single card only, centred, filling the image across its width, 1.00 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 96 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A stat card repeated side by side: a flat slab of deep navy (#1a2a63) with a 1 px lighter navy edge (#33478c), its top-right corner cut on a diagonal, and a thin 3 px coral (#f28884) stripe down its left edge. Plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
